inochi2d.notes: Turn playback uses 12 authored poses at 12 fps. Uniform scale comes from each character's non-transparent colored height, never the 200x360 canvas size; placement remains locked to the authored pelvis landmark.

turnRigContract.scalePolicy: Use the replacement 200x360 transparent fullbody sprites directly. Do not mix old split rig parts into the new turnaround.
turnRigContract.runtimePolicy: Runtime reads flat fullbody turnleft/turnright states for mouse-following turns and Expressions states for neutral/emotion fallback sprites; generated, old, and _source folders are not referenced by manifest states.
turnRigContract.layerIdPolicy: Use the canonical slot id as the layer id for all new angles. Filenames may include direction suffixes, but Pixi layer ids should stay stable across angles.

rigNotes.hip: Use pelvis_vcut as the parent visual socket. Thigh sprites stay separate and rotate under it with overlap margins to hide seams.
rigNotes.spine: upper_abdomen and lower_abdomen should become separate parent containers before enabling waist bends.
rigNotes.face: Use mouth and eye parts as replaceable overlays on top of head or muzzle containers.
rigNotes.hands: Use open/fist hand sprites as pose swaps first; split fingers only if a future interaction needs finger-level control.
rigNotes.front30: front_left30/front_right30 use viewer-space layer ids and a 200x360 absolute rig. Arms are parented shoulder -> forearm -> hand so small raised-arm poses can reuse the same body without regenerating the sprite.
rigNotes.turnAngles20260706: front_left45/front_right45/back_left30/back_right30/back_3q now share the same canonical slots: head, chest_abdomen, pelvis, viewer-space arms and legs, tail segments, and simple face parts. Proportions remain on the 200x360 canvas; layer pivots are conservative root-level placements for later Pixi tuning.
rigNotes.front30MirrorRegen20260706: front_left30 was regenerated to better match the idle face shape; front_right30 is a direct horizontal mirror of it. Both states now use the 22 canonical slots including simple face parts.
rigNotes.backFull20260706: back_full adds a neutral complete rear view with the same 200x360 canvas and canonical split slots; invisible face slots are transparent placeholders.
rigNotes.sideSplit20260706: side_left and side_right are now split into the same 22 canonical slots from their existing 200x360 fullbody art. The side aliases front_left75/front_right75 document their role as near-side bridge frames; proportions were not resized.
rigNotes.walkForward8Frame20260706: Regenerated walk_forward from a single 8-pose sprite sheet so the feet move forward/back in perspective instead of just shifting sideways. Frames are cut to 200x360 with one shared scale factor.

walk_forward.notes: Eight-frame regenerated forward walk cycle. Unlike the earlier rig-offset draft, these frames are cut from a generated walk sprite sheet with forward/back foot depth, contact/down/passing/up poses, foot perspective scale, body compression/lift, opposite arm swing, and tail delay.

pipelineNotes.turnFullbodyReplacement20260708: Replaced the cursor turn flow with flat 200x360 fullbody PNG states: turn_left_010..180 and turn_right_010..180. renderRig is disabled so the new fullbody art is not mixed with old split parts.
pipelineNotes.preserveWalkAndExcitedMotion20260708: Kept the flat fullbody turnaround while restoring walk_forward/walk_start/walk_stop and happy_tail_wag_front as runtime-connected sequences. working is intentionally not regenerated.
pipelineNotes.expressionFullbodyRegen20260708: Regenerated happy/sad/sleepy/speechless/warning/blocked/thinking as distinct flat fullbody expression sprites. working was intentionally left unchanged. Walk and happy tail/excited sequence links remain enabled.
pipelineNotes.turnStepTransitions20260708: Added six-frame left/right 010-to-020 and 020-to-030 flat fullbody bridge sequences with a subtle foot lift, played once during cursor turn step changes.
pipelineNotes.turnStepTransitionsReverse20260708: Added reverse transition mappings for 020-to-010 and 030-to-020 without duplicating image files.

turn_left_010_to_020.notes: Six-frame 10-to-20 degree left-turn bridge with a subtle foot lift arc.

turn_left_020_to_030.notes: Six-frame 20-to-30 degree left-turn bridge with a subtle foot lift arc.

turn_right_010_to_020.notes: Six-frame 10-to-20 degree right-turn bridge with a subtle foot lift arc.

turn_right_020_to_030.notes: Six-frame 20-to-30 degree right-turn bridge with a subtle foot lift arc.

turn_left_020_to_010.notes: Reverse playback of the matching subtle foot-lift turn bridge for smooth return turns.

turn_left_030_to_020.notes: Reverse playback of the matching subtle foot-lift turn bridge for smooth return turns.

turn_right_020_to_010.notes: Reverse playback of the matching subtle foot-lift turn bridge for smooth return turns.
